interpretation: The applet executes a local page and deserializes a Map/Date graph through postMessage. This passes the W1 reachability gate for CVE-2023-28205: the required API surface is present and the structured-clone path completes without an error. It does not show that the build is vulnerable to the CVE, that the MarkedVector fix is absent, or that a crash is reachable. The no-JIT, no-WebAssembly, no-WebGL, no-SharedArrayBuffer, no-Intl, and no-crypto.subtle results are consistent with the 2026-10-26 fingerprint and with the Safari 15.4-15.6 feature bracket.
limitations: One console, one run, one page load. W1 is a reachability test, not a vulnerability test.
No PoC was served and no exploit was attempted. A patched build can still pass this test.
The exact WebKit patch level remains unknown; Nintendo may have backported the CVE-2023-28205 fix.
The log is kept local because it contains request headers and console network identifiers.
A browser compromise would be applet-level only and would not reach Atmosphère without a separate kernel or boot-stage chain.
